scope: CRLF-to-LF at receipt parsing boundary only; existing semantics unchanged
verbatim_statement:
FOUNDER AUTHORIZATION — PR #161 CRLF NORMALIZATION EXTENSION APPROVED

I explicitly authorize a narrowly bounded extension to the existing SG-000031 admission-repair scope in PR #161.

The existing authorization remains unchanged except for the specific parser interoperability repair below.

I authorize:

- Normalize CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings to LF (`\n`) at the receipt parsing boundary before the existing receipt parser applies its current semantic validation.
- Add deterministic regression coverage proving that semantically identical LF and CRLF receipts produce the same parsed result.
- Add or retain negative regression coverage proving that malformed, incomplete, structurally invalid, or semantically invalid receipts remain rejected.
- Document the exact normalization boundary and ensure the normalization does not modify any receipt content other than line-ending representation.
- Use Graft for bounded structural impact analysis.
- Re-run genuine TypeSafe Jev exact-diff semantic review on the new exact head.
- Re-run repository-approved Alibaba OpenCodeReview on the new exact head.
- Re-run the complete required CI, manuscript/arXiv, SDK/native preflight, review-thread, merge, and post-main qualification stack.
- Merge only through a normal merge commit with exact-head / expected-head protection after all required gates pass.

This authorization is strictly limited to line-ending normalization and its necessary regression/documentation evidence.

It does NOT authorize:

- changing receipt schema or semantics
- accepting previously invalid receipt fields or structures
- weakening validation
- generic parser permissiveness
- unrelated parser refactoring
- additional admission fixes discovered later without a new scope decision
- any R2 execution attempt
- any model call
- replay of any of the 1463 development rows
- rerunning SG-000028
- model, tokenizer, GGUF, llama.cpp, FHIR-AgentBench, prompt, tool-schema, agent-strategy, or temperature changes
- retries until favorable
- selective row replay
- final-role access
- D4 activation
- training or fine-tuning
- scoring or final evaluation
- gate waiver

The retained first R2 attempt remains immutable and BLOCKED.

No new execution authorization is created by this repair.

Because this change modifies PR #161's head, qualification evidence from the previous head must not be reused as merge qualification for the new head. The complete required exact-head review and CI stack must qualify the revised candidate.

After the CRLF normalization repair is fully qualified, normally merged, and post-main verified, stop again before any model call and present the canonical repair evidence for a separate founder decision on a possible second R2 execution attempt.

Founder cost must remain zero.
